steps.description: Load raw data into an intermediate staging area using Apache NiFi.
Perform initial data cleaning and preprocessing using Python scripts.
Apply transformations to the data using SQL queries or DBeaver.
Validate transformed data against predefined quality standards using PyTest.
Store cleaned and transformed data in a structured format like Parquet or ORC using Apache Spark.
Analyze existing databases and design new schemas using MySQL Workbench.
Create and configure tables in the new schema using SQL commands.
Optimize table structures and indexes using EXPLAIN PLAN and ANALYZE commands.
Implement constraints and foreign keys to ensure data integrity using ALTER TABLE statements.
Regularly back up the database using Rsync or mysqldump.
Set up monitoring tools like New Relic or Datadog to track database performance.
Configure alerts based on thresholds set by New Relic or Datadog.
Run regular health checks and performance analysis using New Relic Insights or Datadog's dashboarding capabilities.
Identify bottlenecks and optimize queries using SQL tuning techniques.
Document findings and recommendations for future improvements.
Audit current security configurations using Nessus or Qualys.
Update firewall rules and access controls according to the latest security policies.
Implement encryption for sensitive data using SSL/TLS certificates.
Schedule regular penetration testing using Metasploit or similar tools.
Maintain compliance documentation and keep it up-to-date with relevant regulations.
Write comprehensive documentation for all major components of the data infrastructure.
Train junior engineers and team members on best practices and new features.
Collate user feedback and incorporate changes into ongoing development efforts.
Ensure that all stakeholders understand the impact of their decisions on the data architecture.
Review and update documentation regularly to reflect any changes in the environment.
